notes.title: Galaxy squad announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am very happy to announce my new project, Galaxy squad! 
I've been working on it for quite a lot of time, and I'm ready to finally reveal it. 

Galaxy squad is turn-based tactical game, kinda like mix between XCOM and FTL! You are leading a group of characters across randomly generated galaxy, encounter different story events and fight in hardcore tactical battles.

Check out the announcement trailer:

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4MVWPO1Dv4o

And check out steam store page for more info: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/921710/Galaxy_Squad/

Add it to your wishlists and share it with your friends! I am planning to release the game into Early Access at the end of the year!

notes.title: Putrefaction 2 Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello guys! I am very happy to announce that I am working on sequel for Putrefaction, which is called Putrefaction 2: Void Walker.

The game will be very different and improved experience, compared to first title. It is now much more fast-paced, open and colorful shooter, however it still retains impactful and gory gunplay from original. I am aiming to fix all mistakes I had previously and I hope everyone will enjoy this game even more.

Here is a reveal trailer.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eo-xaoP3lsQ

The game is coming in 2017. Stay tuned for updates and subscribe for my twitter: https://twitter.com/OlegKazakov1990

UPDATE:game is now on Greenlight! Please vote!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=805837428

notes.title: New Update released
notes.notes:
Hi guys! New update just been released for he game:

[list]
    [*]A lot of people complained about game being too difficult even on normal, so I reduced difficulty a little. 
    [*]Medkits give more health now
    [*]Less enemies on level 3
    [*]Blade mutants move speed reduced a little
    [*]Enemies spawn points were updated, so there will be less chance that enemy will spawn on top of the player
    [*]Rocket launcher damage was doubled
    [*]A lot of minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thabk you for your feedback and your support!

notes.title: Between The Chasm And The Quake: Putrefaction
notes.notes:
Putrefaction could be the name of a death metal band but it is in fact the name of a first-person shooter that just launched on Steam Early Access. The store page claims it “heavily inspired by old-school shooters from 3D Realms and id Software” and I was expecting hordes of monsters, a swift pace and (possibly) a heavy dose of interactive environmental objects.

What I’ve found, in an hour of playing, is a game closer in sensibility to the first Quake, the most recent Doom or oft-forgotten (and perhaps deservedly) 1997 title Chasm: The Rift. Levels – at least so far – are narrower than the best of Doom, but I’m sufficiently entertained to go back for more.
